title: Quenched Greek Giant Beans Gigantes Plaki
description: A savory, dense Greek bean stew featuring beef stock and a soffritto base, perfect for a brunch mood.

ingredients.name: giant cannellini beans
ingredients.notes: use dried beans soaked overnight and boiled until tender

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté onion, carrot, and celery until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook another minute until fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste and cook 2 minutes to develop flavor.
Pour in beef stock, add cooked beans, oregano, bay leaf, salt, and pepper; bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and let the mixture gently simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove bay leaf, taste, and adjust seasoning if needed.
Transfer the beans to a baking dish, sprinkle chopped parsley on top, and bake at 350°F for 10 minutes to meld flavors.
Serve hot with crusty bread or a side salad for a hearty brunch.
